notes: Hash-object, index (KEY=), and format-driven merge techniques from Merge.sas, fully self-contained via the source file's own inline DATALINES (patients / appointment_log). Two edits vs the source: (1) the Inner_Join step's 'if 0 then set appointment_log patients;' variable-declaration idiom was replaced with an explicit LENGTH statement (the technique the source itself already uses two steps later in Left_Join) because Jenner 0.1.0 hangs to its 30s timeout on the conditional multi-dataset SET form - filed upstream as a regression test in set/; (2) trailing PROC PRINT statements were added since the source file builds datasets without ever printing them, and the final 'Self Join' PROC SQL block (which referenced GOOD/BAD tables never defined anywhere in the source file) was dropped.
